name: Camp Susan Curtis
description_short: Free overnight camp in Stoneham, Maine, for Maine children in grades 5 to 12 from families facing economic hardship, referred by their school. Campers come for a 10 day session with swim lessons, crafts, sports and nature, and older campers move into bridge and leadership programs.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Camp address 236 Allen Road, Stoneham; office in Portland. New campers entering grades 5 to 7 are referred by a school counselor or social worker.

Researched by Claude from this page. Tuition free program for Maine children grade five through high school whose families face economic hardship; 10 day sessions; traditional camp for grades 5 to 7, bridge camp for 8 and 9, leadership for 10 to 12.
Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 brochure: one 10 day session per camper each summer at no cost; free bus routes to and from camp; three meals and a snack daily.

warnings: No session dates are published; families get them in a welcome packet.
Enrollment is by school referral only and camp is free, so no price is listed.
